notes: Authored corrections on top of the local Jolpica driver table (#265). Jolpica carries one given name per driver, so 'Juan Fangio' shows where the person is known as Juan Manuel Fangio. A name field left out keeps the Jolpica value. 'female' marks the few women of the data; every other real driver is male. The list is small on purpose: only a driver whose common name differs from Jolpica, or a woman. An id that is not in the local table is ignored. Entries are matched by the Jolpica driverId.
